ud2.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Kuṇḍiyāyaṃ viharati Kuṇḍiṭṭhānavane.
ud2.8:1.3: tena kho pana samayena Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti
ud2.8:1.4: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā dukkhāhi tibbāhi kharāhi kaṭukāhi vedanāhi phuṭṭhā tīhi vitakkehi adhivāseti:
ud2.8:1.5: sammāsambuddho vata bho bhagavā, yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti,
ud2.8:1.6: suppaṭipanno vata tassa bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho, yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya paṭipanno,
ud2.8:1.7: susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ yadidaṃ evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ na saṃvijjatī 'ti.
ud2.8:2.1: atha kho Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā sāmikaṃ āmantesi:
ud2.8:2.2: ehi tvaṃ ayyaputta, yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
ud2.8:2.3: Suppavāsā bhante Koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī 'ti.
ud2.8:2.5: Suppavāsā bhante Koliyadhītā satta vassāni . . . pe . . .
ud2.8:3.1: paraman ti so Koliyaputto Suppavāsāya Koliyadhītāya paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
ud2.8:3.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Koliyaputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud2.8:3.3: Suppavāsā bhante Koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ . . . phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati
ud2.8:3.5: Suppavāsā bhante Koliyadhītā satta vassāni . . . pe . . .
ud2.8:4.1: sukhinī hotu Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyatū 'ti.
ud2.8:4.2: saha vacanā ca pana bhagavato Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyi.
ud2.8:5.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho so Koliyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena sakaṃ gharaṃ tena paccāyāsi.
ud2.8:5.2: addasā kho Koliyaputto Suppavāsaṃ Koliyadhītaraṃ sukhiniṃ arogaṃ arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātaṃ,
ud2.8:5.4: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nām' ayaṃ Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā saha vacanā pana bhagavato sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyatī 'ti
ud2.8:6.1: atha kho Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā sāmikaṃ āmantesi:
ud2.8:6.2: ehi tvaṃ ayyaputta, yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vadāhi:
ud2.8:6.3: Suppavāsā bhante Koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī 'ti.
ud2.8:6.5: Suppavāsā bhante Koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāresi
ud2.8:6.6: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā etarahi sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā,
ud2.8:6.8: adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā Suppavāsāya Koliyadhītāya satta bhattāni saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
ud2.8:7.1: paraman ti kho so Koliyaputto Suppavāsāya Koliyadhītāya paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
ud2.8:7.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so Koliyaputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud2.8:8.1: Suppavāsā bhante Koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati
ud2.8:9.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho svātanāya bhattena nimantito hoti.
ud2.8:9.2: so ca upāsako āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
ud2.8:9.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi:
ud2.8:9.4: ehi tvaṃ Moggallāna, yena so upāsako ten' upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
ud2.8:9.8: karotu Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā satta bhattāni, pacchā so karissati
ud2.8:10.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno bhagavato paṭissutvā yena so upāsako ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ etad avoca:
ud2.8:10.5: Karotu . . . pe . . . bhattāni, pacchā tvaṃ karissasī 'ti.
ud2.8:11.1: sace me bhante ayyo Mahāmoggallāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:11.2: bhogānañ ca jīvitassa ca saddhāya ca,
ud2.8:11.3: karotu Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā satta bhattāni, pacchā 'haṃ karissāmī 'ti.
ud2.8:11.4: dvinnaṃ kho tesaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:12.1: sace me bhante ayyo Mahāmoggallāno dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:13.1: atho kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ upāsakaṃ saññāpetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud2.8:13.3: karotu Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā satta bhattāni pacchā so karissatī 'ti.
ud2.8:14.1: atha kho Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā sattāhaṃ buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi,
ud2.8:14.2: taṃ ca dārakaṃ bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi sabbañ ca bhikkhusaṃghaṃ.
ud2.8:15.1: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto taṃ dārakaṃ etad avoca:
ud2.8:15.2: kacci te dāraka khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci na kiñci dukkhan ti.
ud2.8:15.3: kuto me bhante Sāriputta khamanīyaṃ, kuto yāpanīyaṃ.
ud2.8:16.2: putto me Dhammasenāpatinā saddhiṃ mantetī 'ti attamanā pamuditā pītisomanassajātā ahosi.
ud2.8:16.3: atha kho bhagavā Suppavāsaṃ Koliyadhītaraṃ etad avoca:
ud2.8:16.4: iccheyyāsi tvaṃ Suppavāse aññaṃ pi evarūpam puttan ti.
ud2.8:16.5: iccheyyām' āhaṃ bhagavā aññāni pi evarūpāni satta puttānī 'ti.
ud2.8:17.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
